title: Editorial Standards
description: Tokenization 2050's editorial standards — how we source, verify, and publish information.
body:
# Editorial Standards

Tokenization 2050 is committed to accuracy, transparency, and editorial independence. These standards govern all content published on the site.

## Sourcing

- All factual claims must be supported by **official sources** (company announcements, regulatory filings, court documents) or **at least two independent sources**.
- Sources are cited at the bottom of every article with dates and links where available.
- Anonymous sources are used only when the information is of significant public interest and cannot be obtained on the record. Anonymous sourcing is noted in the article.

## Accuracy

- All articles are reviewed by at least one editor before publication.
- Market data and financial figures are verified against primary data sources (regulatory filings, on-chain data, or official databases).
- When data is estimated or preliminary, this is clearly stated.

## Corrections

- Errors are corrected promptly and transparently.
- Corrections are noted at the top of the affected article and logged on our [Corrections](/corrections/) page with the date, original error, and correction made.
- If an error is material (affects the meaning or conclusion of the article), the correction is noted in the article headline or summary.

## Independence

- Tokenization 2050 does not accept payment for editorial coverage.
- Sponsored content, if ever introduced, will be clearly labelled and separated from editorial content.
- Editorial staff do not trade in assets covered by Tokenization 2050 during the reporting process.

## News vs. Analysis

- **News articles** report facts and attribute statements to named sources. The editorial voice is neutral.
- **Analysis pieces** (published in the Analysis section) may contain interpretation, opinion, and forward-looking statements. These are clearly labelled.

## Timestamps

- All articles carry a publication timestamp in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
- If an article is materially updated after publication, the update timestamp is shown.

## Byline

All content is published under the byline **Tokenization 2050 Editorial Team**. Individual author names are not used on the site.
